about: Synthetic calls for test/live_diarize_eval.py (#218). Each event is [voice, line, gap] or [voice, line, gap, {"head": share}]: a clip from bank.json placed `gap` seconds after the previous clip ends (negative = overlap); with head, only the first share of the sentence (cut at a gap between words), the speaker cut off mid-sentence. Voices are fake people; bea-far is Bea dialed in by phone; gus is a guest nobody enrolled. `expect` lists the checks that reproduce one real-call failure each.

calls.name: handoff
calls.failure: a segment held the end of one speaker's sentence and the start of the next speaker's reply; the live view gave all of it to one person

calls.name: backchannel
calls.failure: a short reply ("exactly", "right") at a turn boundary went on the wrong person

calls.name: near_far
calls.failure: one known person showed as a named voice plus an unnamed `them` (near mic, then far mic)

calls.name: agree
calls.failure: the same turn was labeled one way live and another way after the call

calls.name: long
calls.failure: a 40+ minute call that returns to topics (and people) after long stretches
